name: Hypnophobia; From Your Shadow
source:
Hypnophobia: From your Shadow is a kinetic visual novel about Iris, a gorgonian who develops hypnophobia (fear of sleeping) due to the nightmares and memories that haunt her in her sleep after moving to Stalva, the most northern city in the world. Iris tries her best to improve, but can she actually do it?

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/4458830/]Steam[/url]]
